subject: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for CinderEdge pilot
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for CinderEdge pilot

Hi Vanessa / Lauren,

Catching up from the demo last week — CinderEdge (contact: Marta Ruiz) is asking to start a 6-week pilot for our embeddings/llm inference for one internal team. Expected spend ~ $3.2k over the pilot (monthly invoices). Procurement kicked back on our standard PO mandate for new vendors. They asked whether we can allow a temporary no-PO onboarding path for pilots under $5k with an evidence package.

Quick context: this is a strategic partner prospect (DEAL-8249) and teams want to move immediately. CinderEdge has provided a security self-attestation and a short MSA summary (attached). Marta says they can sign our SOW after the pilot; they prefer invoice-first to avoid procurement back-and-forth slowing the trial.

Ask: Can Procurement approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for this pilot with the attached evidence (security attestation + vendor summary) and a 30-day payment term, subject to a PO being raised if we convert to paid? If there are specific controls you want (e.g., payment hold, spend cap, legal clause), call them out and I’ll negotiate.

Attachments: CinderEdge_SecuritySelfAttestation.pdf; CinderEdge_MSA_summary.pdf; pilot-scope-worksheet.xlsx

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@cinderedge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cinderedge.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for CinderEdge pilot

Hi Rishi — thanks for looping us in.

We’re happy to proceed under the proposed pilot terms. Quick notes:
- Security: attached is the self-attestation (we’ve redacted internal IP references). We also completed your security intake questionnaire last month; happy to reshare that doc.
- Contracting: we can sign a short SOW (one page) after the pilot. For the pilot invoices we can bill Net30 to the Redwood billing contact you provide.
- Data handling: no customer PII will be uploaded during the pilot; it’s strictly internal feature telemetry.

Attachment stubs: [Attachment: CinderEdge_SecuritySelfAttestation.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: CinderEdge_MSA_summary.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: pilot-scope-worksheet.xlsx (XLSX)]

Let me know the billing contact and any procurement controls required. Looking forward to getting started this week.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Partnerships
CinderEdge Labs
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for CinderEdge pilot

Rishi — thanks for the summary and for attaching the attestation. I reviewed the materials quickly. A few procurement controls we need before we can approve invoice-only onboarding for an external vendor: 

1) Spend cap and automatic stop: we require a $4k hard cap for the pilot and notification to procurement at 80% utilization.
2) Billing contact + remit details: we need a billing email and tax ID on the invoice.
3) Legal posture: at minimum we need the MSA summary and a confirmation that the pilot data is non-PII. If this is true, add an explicit line in the email from the vendor confirming no-PII.
4) Finance pre-approval: Lauren needs to sign off on the temporary exception for this deal (criteria: pilot < $5k, vendor evidence provided, payment Net30).

If Lauren approves, Procurement can provision the vendor in the billing system under a temporary 'invoice-only' label for 6 weeks. We will require the SOW or a PO to be raised if the engagement converts.

Please ask CinderEdge to respond to items 1–3 and I’ll queue the onboarding.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@cinderedge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for CinderEdge pilot

Marta — quick follow-up with procurement asks below so we can get you live. Can you confirm the three items Vanessa requested? I pasted them here for convenience: 

1) We need a billing contact + tax ID on invoices (billing email and remit address).
2) Please confirm in writing that no customer PII will be processed during the pilot (self-attestation attached).
3) We will set a hard spend cap of $4,000 for the pilot and require a notification to procurement at 80% usage.

If you can confirm 1–2 in an email reply today, and agree to the spend cap, Vanessa will provision the temporary onboarding. Lauren — can you confirm Finance ok with Net30 + temporary exception for pilots < $5k if Procurement signs off on the above?

Thanks — Rishi
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: temporary no-PO onboarding for CinderEdge pilot

All — reviewed. Finance approves the temporary invoice-only onboarding under these conditions:
- Pilot spend <= $4,000 (hard cap).
- Payment terms Net30.
- Procurement to tag the vendor as 'temp-invoice-only' and monitor at 80% usage trigger.
- Legal to be engaged if the pilot converts; a PO or signed SOW required before ongoing spend.

Vanessa, please proceed to provision and notify billing ops of the vendor record. Rishi: please share billing email and tax ID from CinderEdge when you have it so we can complete the vendor record.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Finance Director | Redwood Inference
